name: Jesus‘ Spectral Intervention: Derrida, Christianity, And
headline: Jesus‘ Spectral Intervention: Derrida, Christianity, And
description: Jesus, who was concerned till manhood with his own personal development, was free from the contagious sickness of his age and his people; free from the inhibited inertia which expends its one activity on the common needs and conveniences of life; free too from the ambition and other desires whose satisfaction, once craved, would have compelled him to make terms with prejudice and vice.
